roughness.note: Clamped after texture sampling. Prevents 0=perfect mirror and 1=pure diffuse extremes

emissive.note: emissive = albedo * albedoMul * metal.b * strengthMul. b channel of roughMetal tex = emissive

ggx.note: Denominator epsilon to avoid divide-by-zero in NDF

fresnel.note: F0 for non-metals. Mix with albedo by metalness
